references.text: The basis for the Levitical cities with their pasturelands around the cities, which also applies to Dimnah and Nahalal mentioned in Joshua 21:35.
Nahalal is mentioned as one of the cities in Zebulun's inheritance, the same city given to the Levites in Joshua 21:35.
Nahalal is mentioned again here, where it states that Zebulun did not drive out the inhabitants of Nahalal, which is the same city given to the Levites.
Parallel account of the Levitical cities given to the sons of Merari from the various tribes.
